description: Flat, record-level metadata schema for soil samples collected from agricultural fields for seasonal metagenomic analysis of microbial community diversity, composition, and environmental drivers.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample record.

study_id.descr: Identifier for the broader study or project to which this sample belongs.

site_id.descr: Identifier for the geographic field site or location.

field_name.descr: Human-readable name of the agricultural field or farm site.

plot_id.descr: Identifier for the specific plot, sub-plot, or sampling unit within the field.

sample_replica_number.descr: Replicate number for the sample within the same site/date/plot; use an integer such as 1, 2, 3.

collection_date.descr: Date of soil sample collection in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_time.descr: Local time of sample collection if available, in 24-hour format (HH:MM:SS).

season.descr: Season during which the sample was collected; for example spring, summer, autumn, winter, dry season, or wet season.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

administrative_region.descr: State, province, district, or equivalent administrative region of the sampling location.

locality.descr: Nearest town, village, or locality name associated with the sampling site.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees; use WGS84 coordinates.

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees; use WGS84 coordinates.

elevation_m.descr: Sampling site elevation above sea level in meters (m).

crop_type.descr: Primary crop grown in the field at the time of sampling, if applicable.

agricultural_system.descr: General agricultural setting or management system, such as conventional, organic, regenerative, irrigated, rainfed, greenhouse, or fallow.

soil_type.descr: Soil classification or textural class, such as loam, sandy loam, clay, silt loam, or a formal soil taxonomy label.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval of the sampled soil in centimeters (cm); record the depth of collection or depth range if represented consistently.

composited_sample.descr: Indicates whether the record represents a composite of multiple subsamples (true/false).

number_of_subsamples.descr: Number of individual subsamples combined to create the final soil sample, if composited.

sample_mass_g.descr: Mass of soil collected for the sample in grams (g).

soil_pH.descr: Measured soil pH, typically from soil-water or soil-CaCl2 suspension; specify method in the pH method field if needed.

soil_pH_method.descr: Method used to measure soil pH, such as soil:water ratio or soil:CaCl2 ratio.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as a percentage (%), on a wet-weight basis or as otherwise defined in the protocol.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at sampling time in degrees Celsius (°C).

soil_electrical_conductivity.descr: Soil electrical conductivity, typically in dS/m or mS/cm; include the unit and method in accompanying protocol documentation.

soil_organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content as a percentage (%), if measured.

soil_organic_carbon_percent.descr: Soil organic carbon content as a percentage (%), if measured.

nitrate_mg_kg.descr: Soil nitrate concentration in milligrams per kilogram (mg/kg), if measured.

phosphate_mg_kg.descr: Soil phosphate concentration in milligrams per kilogram (mg/kg), if measured.

salinity.descr: Soil salinity measurement, if available; specify the value in the chosen unit in associated documentation.

moisture_measurement_method.descr: Method or instrument used to determine soil moisture, such as gravimetric or sensor-based measurement.

temperature_measurement_method.descr: Method or instrument used to determine soil temperature, such as probe or data logger.

sample_storage_temperature_c.descr: Temperature at which the sample was stored after collection, in degrees Celsius (°C), such as -80, -20, or 4.

time_from_collection_to_extraction_h.descr: Elapsed time between sample collection and nucleic acid extraction in hours (h).

dna_extraction_method.descr: Protocol used for nucleic acid extraction, including kit name or in-house method.

dna_extraction_kit.descr: Commercial kit name or extraction reagent set used for DNA extraction, if applicable.

dna_extraction_date.descr: Date on which nucleic acid extraction was performed in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

dna_input_mass_g.descr: Mass of soil input used for nucleic acid extraction in grams (g).

dna_yield_ng.descr: Total DNA yield recovered from extraction in nanograms (ng).

dna_concentration_ng_ul.descr: DNA concentration measured after extraction in nanograms per microliter (ng/µL).

dna_purity_a260_a280.descr: DNA purity ratio measured at A260/A280, if available.

dna_storage_buffer.descr: Buffer or solution used to store extracted DNA, such as TE or nuclease-free water.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation protocol used for sequencing library construction.

library_kit.descr: Library preparation kit name, if applicable.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used, such as Illumina NovaSeq, MiSeq, HiSeq, Oxford Nanopore, or PacBio.

sequencing_center.descr: Laboratory or facility where sequencing was performed.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run associated with this sample.

library_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing library derived from this sample.

read_layout.descr: Sequencing read layout, such as single-end, paired-end, or long-read.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs (bp) for short-read sequencing, if applicable.

insert_size_bp.descr: Expected library insert size in base pairs (bp), if applicable.

target_region.descr: Targeted nucleic acid type or region; for metagenomics this is typically whole metagenome DNA, not amplicon-based target.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw sequencing reads generated for the sample.

raw_base_count_bp.descr: Total number of raw bases generated for the sample in base pairs (bp).

quality_filtering_performed.descr: Indicates whether reads were quality filtered before downstream analysis (true/false).

assembly_performed.descr: Indicates whether sequencing reads from this sample were assembled into contigs (true/false).

assembly_method.descr: Assembly software and key settings used, if assembly was performed.

binning_performed.descr: Indicates whether metagenome-assembled genome binning was performed (true/false).

taxonomic_profiling_method.descr: Method or tool used for taxonomic classification or abundance profiling, such as Kraken2, MetaPhlAn, or similar.

functional_annotation_method.descr: Method or tool used for functional annotation, if applicable.

reference_database.descr: Reference database name and version used for taxonomic or functional analysis.

bioinformatic_pipeline.descr: Name of the computational pipeline used to process the metagenomic data.

pipeline_version.descr: Version of the bioinformatic pipeline or workflow.

data_accession.descr: Accession number or persistent identifier for raw or processed sequence data in a public repository.

sample_notes.descr: Free-text notes on unusual sample conditions, deviations from protocol, contamination concerns, or other relevant observations.
